2610.08541.title: Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control
2610.08541.paper_summary: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.
2610.08541.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們研究微型神經政策（MNP）的合成，以使計算受限的嵌入式設備能夠實現安全且穩健的實時機器人控制。<lb/>我們證明，將進化策略（ES）和基於統計模型檢查（SMC）的政策搜索驗證相結合，可以顯著減少神經網絡的大小，而不會妨礙安全性和穩健性。<lb/>我們對MNP在平衡桿和四旋翼控制任務上的大規模訓練和評估進行了研究，變化控制頻率和網絡架構。<lb/>在模擬中驗證這些政策後，我們通過零樣本轉移到物理系統來評估它們的可部署性。<lb/>我們的實驗表明，MNP可以成功實現安全的模擬到現實轉移，而不犧牲控制性能。<lb/>然後，我們展示了這些政策的內存佔用範圍從0.5到7.5 kB，允許在微控制器上部署，並在不超過25 ns的抖動下實現實時推理延遲，同時讓芯片在超過97%的時間內保持閒置以處理額外的工作負載。<lb/>這使它們成為對資源極度受限的機器人系統的高度實用解決方案。
